mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the iris completed a planned ray diagram linking cornea, pupil, lens and retina. It brought the separate components together in a useful explanation of focusing and light control.

leastWorthwhile.text: The individual fittings were straightforward and somewhat repetitive, although their insets helped distinguish their functions.

surprise.text: The comparison between light entering the eye and nerve signals leaving it made the change in signal form especially clear.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though adding the muscles before joining the eyes to the body was a practical guess rather than a clearly required order.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the constructions connected familiar biology to anatomy clearly, especially the distinction between incoming light and outgoing nerve signals. The planned illustrations and prose are promising, though they do not establish how well students would understand them.
